description.narrative: The project will support expansion of Indonesia's geothermal generating capacity to contribute to the sustainability and sufficiency of the electricity system, aligned with Sustainable Development Goal 7: access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all. The project will support GDE, a state-owned geothermal company focused on exploration and development of geothermal resources, to commission an additional 100 megawatts (MW) of geothermal electricity generating capacity 55 MW at the Dieng geothermal field in Central Java and 55 MW at the Patuha geothermal field in West Java.

Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional capacity of GDE strengthened Indicator: At least 10 GDE staff (of whom at least 20% are women) reported increased knowledge of geothermal reservoir performance in geothermal operations (2019 baseline: None) Achievement: 1003 staff(cum) Progress/Status: As of 30 Sep 2025: GDE reported that 1,086 male staff (86%) and 178 female staff (14%) were trained in geothermal operations. The training of GDE staff on geothermal operations will continue throughout the project implementation phase. Data Source: Project management consultant report Actual value: 1003 staff(cum)

Output: Institutional capacity of GDE strengthened Indicator: 400 GDE staff training days (at least 30% women staff training days) dedicated to increasing knowledge in project and contract management (Baseline: 11% women staff training days out of 140 staff training days) Achievement: 39 Progress/Status: As of 30 Sep 2025: The total number of GDE staff training days dedicated to increasing knowledge in project and contract management already reached 733 days, of which, 454 training days (62%) were for male staff and 279 training days (38%) were for women staff. The target of 30% women training days have been achieved. The training will continue throughout the project implementation phase. Data Source: Project management consultant report

Output: Geothermal power plants constructed and commissioned Indicator: Additional 55 MW geothermal electricity generating plant and transmission at Dieng commissioned by 2025 Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All ten wells (6 production and 4 injection wells) were successfully drilled and tested. EPC power plant contract awarded in December 2025, with COD anticipated in Q4 2027 or Q1 2028 Data Source: GDE annual reports

Output: Geothermal power plants constructed and commissioned Indicator: Additional 55 MW geothermal electricity generating plant including advanced low-carbon technologies and transmission interconnection at Patuha commissioned by 2025 Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All twelve production wells were successfully drilled and tested. The EPC contract was awarded to consortium of PT Inti Karya Persada Teknik, INO and PT Wasa Mitra Engineering, INO and the contract was signed on 12 Dec 2024 and became effective in January 2025. COD still targeted for Q2 2027. Data Source: GDE annual reports and technology review by JFJCM consultant

Output: Community development program enhanced Indicator: Feasibility study for direct use of geothermal energy for community economic activities developed, including a specific strategy for maximizing livelihood opportunities for women in the project communities (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The feasibility study for a geothermal direct-use project, with the potential to enhance livelihood opportunities for community members incorporating feedback from ADB during the loan review mission in October 2023, was completed on 28 May 2024. Data Source: Project management consultant reports Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Community development program enhanced Indicator: Gender-responsive communication and outreach strategies developed and delivered in each community (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: Y (ongoing) Progress/Status: GDE's corporate and community communication strategy was developed in 2022, and gender-responsive communication materials both in Bahasa and English were published and are regularly being developed to align with the ongoing field activities. GDE has updated its communications standard operating procedures and has closely coordinated outreach and consultations with affected communities. These activities will continue throughout the project implementation phase. Data Source: Project management consultant reports Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: Y (ongoing)

Output: Community development program enhanced Indicator: Gender-responsive community development strategy developed and implemented, with 30% budgetary allocation for women's livelihoods and women's scholarships (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: Y (ongoing) Progress/Status: GDE is implementing the gender-responsive community development strategy, in 2025 it has developed and has allocated a budget of 36% for Dieng and 45% for Patuha to women's livelihoods and women's scholarships. Data Source: Project management consultant reports Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: Y (ongoing)

Output: Institutional capacity of GDE strengthened Indicator: Environmental management system (EMS) expanded to cover new facilities and incorporate gender, climate, and community safety considerations (2019 baseline: EMS for unit 1 only) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The Environmental Management System, which includes new facilities and integrates aspects of gender, climate, and community safety, was finalized and certified in early Q2 2023. Certifications and accreditations for ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 37001:2016 for Dieng 2 and Patuha 2 were achieved in 2022 and being renewed every three years, and SMK3 PP 50/2012 accreditation is underway.
